header: Which trades use the platform most
subheadline: The platform started with refrigeration contractors. Today these four trades make up most of the 640 companies on it, each with its own setup.

items.title: Refrigeration and cooling
items.description: F-gas certificates checked on every assignment, refrigerant logged per unit and leak-test intervals that create their own visits.

items.title: Lift and escalator servicing
items.description: Statutory inspection dates per unit, a 30-minute response time for entrapment calls and a signed record for the building owner.

items.title: Building services and HVAC
items.description: Planned maintenance across many sites, with caretaker contacts, key codes and access times stored per building.

items.title: Industrial equipment dealers
items.description: Warranty work is separated from billable work when a job closes. Manufacturer claims and customer invoices never mix.
